title: Equipment Class Wear Rate on Optional Coverage Add-Ons Cash Settlements
content:
**Wear schedule.** For the wear of the failed equipment, an equipment class rate applies to a cash settlement under the Optional Coverage Add-Ons, multiplied with the cash rate:

| Component of the request being settled | Equipment class rate |
|---|---|
| A pump, a motor or a blower: the pool pump, spa pump, septic pump, aerobic pump or well pump; the pool motor; the spa blower | 0.90 (90 percent) |
| A pool heater or a spa heater | 0.85 (85 percent) |
| Any other component | One |

**Hypothetical cases.** A failed spa blower: 0.90. A failed pool heater: 0.85. A failed pressure switch: one, so the cash rate stands alone.
